dom.scene: A harbor rescue-equipment workshop in crisp morning light. As an equipment specialist, she checks an unbranded orange buoyancy vest laid on the workbench, one hand lightly steadying the fabric while the other checks a buckle without overlapping fingers. Waterproof cases and hanging ropes in the background. Both hands visible in a waist-up working composition; no other person.
dom.outfit: A sleeveless burnt-orange utility romper with a structured V-neck zip front, practical pockets and short legs, a navy waist belt and tiny spiral zipper charm. Bare arms and thighs, original practical workshop fashion, no armor, no robot parts, no authentic service insignia.
